>*
All funtions have namespaces, as we used the length or out
we used "STD->out" where the STD is the namespaces
namespaces before the -> has to be passed when we are in
different namespaces (well, because we haven't defined
any namespace we technically were in STD and didn't need
to use the STD-> but it's bad practice). Namespaces are
defined with middle-processor with command:
*<

>*
functions are defined with keyword def then you can say public / private
if you say nothing it's by default public which means it can be called from
other namespaces (private can only be called from the same namespace)

intputs are defined by 'type : name', nire can be defined in the same
way separated by commans

possible types:
 int (arrays and int)
 string (string only)
 any (all types, string, num etc.)
